ideas.pitch: A training-free semantic router for real-time aerospace support queries, routing user intents between fast local models and heavy cloud LLMs based on kNN exemplar indices.
ideas.title: AstraRouter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the proven architecture of darwin-router which won first prize at the Superlinked x Qwen Hackathon by slashing inference costs and latency via self-improving exemplar indexes.

ideas.pitch: A pre-deployment risk diagnosis tool for generative AI workflows that parses BPMN business process models and orchestrates coded agents to catch compliance failures before production.
ideas.title: BPMNAgentGuard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the success of fde-agent-uipath which won 3rd place at UiPath AgentHack by bridging rigid enterprise BPMN standards with dynamic agentic risk governance.

ideas.pitch: An efficiency wrapper for LLMs combining reinforcement learning and trajectory rainbows to compress multi-step chain-of-thought token usage without sacrificing reasoning depth.
ideas.title: HyperReason
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the core technical pattern of hyperreasoning which took 1st place at the OpenAI Hackathon by tackling raw LLM computational efficiency.

ideas.pitch: An offline AI code review engine optimized for neural processing units, providing zero-latency security checks and style enforcement completely disconnected from external APIs.
ideas.title: NPUCodeAudit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly applies the runner-up strategy of DevMesh at the Qualcomm Snapdragon Multiverse Hackathon by emphasizing hardware-local offline execution and privacy.

ideas.pitch: A zero-config native auto-embedding and RAG toolkit that hooks directly into MariaDB to automatically index documents and manage vector search vectors without external vector databases.
ideas.title: AutoEmbeddingRAG
ideas.why_it_could_win: Emulates seamless-rag which secured 2nd place at the MariaDB Hackathon by deeply integrating developer tooling directly into a specific database ecosystem.
